purpose: Teach: 毛沢東/ホークス/バーゲン/ダービー/ペナルティ/ガンバ/レーガン/プリンス

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で毛沢東習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you learned about Mao in history, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation, testing him. Light, teasing energy. Leans forward slightly with a small gotcha-grin. Expects him to deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ホークスのファンだったな、桜
lines.en: You're a Hawks fan, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turns it back on her smoothly, no pause. Quiet amusement underneath. Not defensive — just matching her rhythm, keeping her guessing. Slight lift at the end like he's enjoying this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バーゲンで限定品買ってたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you buying limited edition stuff at a sale once.
lines.style: Confident call-out, grounded observation. Not accusatory, just stating fact. Brief pause before the reveal, like she's watching his face for the reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、競馬のダービー予想してたな、桜
lines.en: You were analyzing horse-racing odds last week, weren't you?
lines.style: Smooth counter-attack, half-amused. Delivered with the confidence of someone who has seen something and won't forget it. Eyes on her, waiting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ペナルティキックの練習してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were out there practicing penalty kicks the other day.
lines.style: Stating observation-as-fact. Slight smile in the voice. Calm, not rushing. Sits back a little, like she's just landed a point and knows it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ガンバ大阪のユニフォーム着てたな、桜
lines.en: You were wearing a Gamba Osaka jersey last month, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirror-calm of her tone. Direct observation, no fluff. Quiet satisfaction that he's been noticing too. Even pacing, weight behind each detail.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でレーガン政権習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you learned about the Reagan administration in history, right?
lines.style: Repeating the setup from earlier, escalating slightly. Confident now. She's building toward something. Steady pace, slight emphasis on the question mark.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、プリンスホテルで結婚式したな、桜
lines.en: Your family had your wedding at the Prince Hotel, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final play — bigger reveal, intimate detail. Delivered quietly but with full eye contact. The tone says: I notice everything about you. Not creepy — just attentive. Small smile.
